last_debrief:
STORY SO FAR: Sat 08-15, day 4 in country. LOW-POWER DAY BY HIS OWN PICK -- 'low power I'm really suffering jet lag' -- so the ear twin ran instead of Table Rehearsal. It was the right call and it paid.

THE EAVESDROP LANDED, AND IT LANDED ON THE STARVING AXIS. Two-auntie tape at native speed, deliberately under coverage, win = who/what/mood. He returned: 'our Sudha I heard is going to get married next month, in a hurry. not a single problem. Savitha is annoyed.' Breakdown: -aam fired TWICE as hearsay and he rendered it 'I heard' unprompted (frame:hearsay-aam, ear-only, working). frame:youknow-la read correctly -- 'our Sudha' came off namma...irukkaanga-la, and that item was STRUGGLED going in. He got the whole event (kalyanam / next month / avasaram) which is the hardest part of the tape. Two misses: avanga ponnu -- it is Sudha's DAUGHTER marrying, he collapsed the landmark-person into the subject (gossip locates you by whose-mother-whose-daughter before it tells you anything); and he flipped WHO was annoyed -- Athai is the aggrieved one (naan ellaam pannanum-nu sonnaanga, naan-e!), Savitha is the calm one telling her nee vittudu / nee poi ukkaaru.

THE CALLBACK THAT WROTE ITSELF. Athai's tell is the -e clitic -- naan-e, 'ME, of all people'. He fired naane COLD on a novel slot 24h earlier (amma asks who made the coffee). Produced Thursday, met in the wild Saturday, same job. Named it to him; it is the cleanest evidence yet that the two lanes feed each other and it cost me nothing to point at.

TRAILER PAID AT THE DOOR. po/podu carved in phonetics only -- ponga (clear off) vs podunga (serve it), sattai podu and medhuva ponga set side by side since he owned both halves and had never seen them adjacent, plus potten vs ponen. Surface split held all session; zero Tamil script in chat. That friction has not recurred.

NEW SLIP, AND IT IS THE SLEEPER-CELL INSTINCT MADE VISIBLE. Ambush at close (nothing named, normal-reading situation: 'she says it again at full speed and you got half -- what comes out of your mouth?'). He gave 'aiyaiyo' or 'appadiyaa'. NOT a freeze -- he fired, and both are legitimate table moves, so it is a pass on the antifreeze bar. But it is a BLUFF: appadiyaa buys the seat and not the sentence, she carries on at the same speed, and he falls further behind. Logged as bluff-not-repair. Recast with the one clause and DID NOT ask it back -- the standing failure (write the answer above his head, then demand it) got broken today on purpose.

ZERO COLD FIRES. Honest: he chose the low-power twin, the catch wins are recognition-side, and the one ambush drew a bluff not a repair. The day counts, but the production axis did not move.

STILL OPEN: mission collect from 08-14 (naane eduthukkaren at a meal) NEVER ANSWERED -- he skipped it at the open and I let it go rather than nag a jet-lagged man; re-collect tomorrow with the new one. M88 still unlistened. Savitha akka eavesdrop knock from 08-14 still unopened. english-word-order 2x, escalated, untested for 6 days. TONIGHT'S MISSION: innoru thadava sollunga, out loud, to a face, when someone comes at him fast -- the repair line instead of the bluff. The house hands him that slot hourly.

soak_order.scene_seed: a man on a bad phone line to a government office, where the clerk talks fast and he keeps saying appadiyaa to cover — until the call ends and he realises he still does not know which day to come; then the same call, run again, where he asks for the repeat twice and walks away with the date
soak_order.focus: TODAY'S LIVE SLIP (bluff-not-repair): he answered a full-speed ambush with 'appadiyaa' — a real table move, but it buys the SEAT and not the SENTENCE. Carve what each one BUYS, do not just gloss them. appadiyaa/aiyaiyo keep the speaker going at the SAME speed and hide the miss; innoru thadava sollunga and konjam medhuva sollunga cost nothing socially and actually change what he receives. The A/B is the whole dose — same conversation twice, bluffed then repaired, so the price of the bluff is AUDIBLE rather than explained. Both repair lines are hinted-never-cold and survival tier; he has been handed them and has never chosen one under pressure. Ride frame:youknow-la in the background (it is ear-only, struggled, and it READ correctly for the first time in today's eavesdrop tape) — let the fast speaker open with namma-{person}-irukkaanga-la so the repair gets fired at genuine gossip speed, not at a slowed teaching voice.
